messages:
Noah: quick brainstorm we need a lightweight "postcard" (3 visuals) + a short webinar for people who click through. Primary goal: signups for sandbox and webinar registrants for larger accounts.

Lina: love the two-stage funnel. postcard should make one clear claim: "Predictable latency, transparent token economics". keep hero < 6 words.

Noah: hero draft: Stop paying surprise inference bills. sub: 3 charts that show how routing, batching, and caching lower costs without blowing up tail latency.

Evan: chart ideas: 1) scatter: cost per 1k tokens vs median latency (hosted vs dedicated) 2) stacked area: percent of requests served from cache over time 3) bar: p95/p99 delta with and without auto-batching. callouts: show realistic prompt mix (chat + retrieval + short completion).

Jules: annotate the scatter with two highlighted points: small prompt (low cost, low latency) and long context (higher cost). one-liner takeaway under each chart.

Kara: audience + routing: if an email clicker uses a corporate domain -> show demo booking; personal domains -> show sandbox signup. capture "company size" on the form (3 buckets) to route to SDR queue.

Noah: routing mechanics: utm_campaign=bench_postcard, utm_variant=A/Bsubs. landing page detects email domain after submit and shows next-step CTA. need HubSpot form id for enterprise flow (placeholder HS_FORM_ENTERPRISE).

Evan: engineering needs to confirm numbers for hosted vs dedicated + a quantized 4-bit run. also want a CSV export so design can generate chart PNGs. I'll ping eng now.

Lina: copy snippets for email body (short):
- opening: "Tired of unpredictable inference bills?"
- blurb: "We measured typical app mixes and found automated batching + prefix caching can reduce token spend by 2-4x while keeping p99 within 50ms of baseline."
- CTA buttons: "Try the sandbox (5 min)" and "Book a 20-min demo"

Jules: subject line A: "Reduce inference cost without trading latency" B: "How predictable is your inference bill?" we'll A/B both.

Noah: webinar hook: 20 minutes demo + 10 minutes Q&A. demo script: show sandbox run, show charts, show a 2-min GIF of batching at work. invite platform eng and SRE to co-host.

Kara: webinar landing form fields: name, email, company, role, company size (ranges), "interested in Dedicated?" checkbox. add hidden field "campaign_bucket" = postcard_variant. map to HS_FORM_WEBINAR.

Evan: dev copy for email fold (include quick test example):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-bench-v1","prompt":"Test latency","max_tokens":50}' \
```

Noah: metrics to track: click-to-signup %, webinar conversion %, demo-book rate for corporate domains, p99-reduction PR mentions, cost-per-acquisition. set UTM params and pass to GA & HubSpot.

Lina: timeline: draft postcard + copy by Tue noon, eng numbers by Tue EOD, design PNGs + GIF Wed, landing pages + forms Thu, QA Fri, send test Monday, live Tue week after.

Evan: note for design: make the 3 charts readable on mobile. single-column stack with short captions. GIF should be 3-6s loop, small.

Jules: legal: any customer quote needs sign-off. if we use anonymized metric ("beta customer saw p99 variability cut in half"), get attestation from CSM.

marketing-bot: Campaign drafted: id=camp_7402, assets folder: https://drive.redwood/bench-postcard-7402, test send scheduled 2024-11-05T15:00:00Z.

Noah: sweet. I'll put the HubSpot form ids in the campaign doc when available. tagging @Evan for eng numbers and @Kara for form scaffolding.

Kara: will draft forms and send stub ids by EOD.

Evan: pinged eng in #eng-ml for numbers. ETA Wed noon.

Noah: thanks team. let's keep copy tight and claims conservative. update thread when numbers land. :white_check_mark:
